reason: A Windows system-tray launcher for starting, opening, restarting, and exiting a local DeepSeek Harness web service, with local process control, browser launching, notifications, and logging.

summaries.zh: 用于在 Windows 托盘中一键启动、打开、重启和退出本地 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务的轻量启动器。
summaries.en: A lightweight Windows tray launcher for starting, opening, restarting, and exiting a local DeepSeek Harness web service.

capabilities: Runs and restarts a local DSh web service
Terminates the process occupying local port 3080
Opens the local DSh service in an Edge app window
Displays tray notifications and writes local logs
